description: Runs `npm run build` when package.json has a build script, then `tgcloud push`. Use this after front-end edits: a plain push uploads static.source as it sits on disk and never runs the bundler, so it would publish a stale dist. Does not migrate the database and never passes --force. skip_build=true pushes without building. If there is no build script, only push runs.

project_dir.description: Absolute path to a tgcloud project directory (contains .tgcloud/)

skip_build.description: true — skip npm run build and only push

name: deploy
title: Build the Mini App and push
